Ivy (AE): customer sent back an orderform and redlined the billing section. They want one MSA but split invoices to two entities; asked for net60 for the POC. Need confirmation on DocuSign routing + VAT handling. cc @Marco (SalesOps)

Marco (SalesOps): can you share legal entity names and VAT for UK? if split invoices, we usually do two orderform envelopes referencing a single MSA envelope.

Ivy (AE): Entities: 'HealthBridge US, Inc.' and 'HealthBridge UK Ltd', VAT GB123456789. No HSM requested; they asked DPA to mention KMS rotation. Uploading redline now.

Dina (Legal): okay. legal checklist: request subprocessors list for the DPA, confirm if they require UK Addendum/SCCs, and decide who signs MSA vs orderform. propose MSA -> Customer GC; Orderforms -> Finance. will review redline.

Ravi (Finance): for split billing we need PO numbers per entity and billing addresses. UK invoices must include VAT id and indicate reverse-charge if they say so. single wire ok if remittance lists both invoices. Net60 for POC requires controller approval.

Ivy (AE): i'll ask customer for POs, subprocessors list, and preferred payment flow. will update when they reply. thanks all :thumbsup:
